test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
If the digits of each number are written in reverse order and then the numbers are arranged in descending order, the position of how many numbers will NOT change?

7846, 6354, 8745, 4653
solution:
Given:-

7846, 6354, 8745, 4653

Arrangement of digits of each number in reverse order:-

7846 → 6487; 6354 → 4536; 8745 → 5478; 4653 → 3564 

Numbers after arrangement:-

6487, 4536, 5478, 3564

Arrangement of numbers in descending order:-

6487 > 5478 > 4536 > 3564

Hence, the correct answer is **"Two".**
